description: Searches Booking.com for `location` and returns the properties as JSON: `name`, `price` (with `checkin`/`checkout`), `reviewScore`, `address`, coordinates, `image` and a hotel `url`. Set `adults`, `children`, `rooms` and `currency`, and collect up to `max_results` across pages. Prices only appear when check-in/check-out dates are given. Returns JSON. Billed like an API request; listing plugins bill one unit per result page they fetch, so keep max_results modest.

currency.description: Price currency: USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, CHF, JPY, CNY, INR, BRL, MXN, PLN, SEK, NOK, DKK, AED, SGD, ZAR, TRY, RUB. Default: USD.

location.description: City or place to search, e.g. 'Austin' or 'Paris'.

max_results.description: How many properties to collect across pages. Default: 25.

proxy_country.description: Proxy country the request is sent from (ISO-2, e.g. 'US', 'DE').

name: booking_hotels
title: Scrape Booking.com hotels
